title: Preserve canonical CRM files through a verified cross-account snapshot
description: Given a complete source inventory and an agreed quiescent final snapshot, when a replacement Virtuus store is initialized in papyrus-production, then canonical paths/bytes/history/issueIDs are preserved, destination native revisions and supplemental catalog are validated, concurrent source writes are reconciled, and the source remains intact. Never blindly copy source-specific catalog pointers. Identity/S3 worker owns the storage contract; no competing schema or namespace redesign.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Acceptance update: Ryan confirmed authenticated access works on the replacement. Fresh complete inventories found zero issue objects in source and destination; the sole operational configuration in each is 1536 bytes with identical SHA256 6470069400767d619c9269b3aa41d19f884c3561d4c32256e2b7ce886153e185. No customer issue/history transfer was needed. Source remains intact; no account retirement or deletion. This establishes the inspected empty-record migration result, not a general populated-store snapshot/history migration proof.
